description: This Java interface defines a Spring Data JPA repository for managing Loan entities, including various query methods to retrieve, update, and check loan data based on different criteria such as status, dates, external IDs, and loan relationships within the Apache Fineract loan management module.

classes.name: LoanRepository
classes.description: A repository interface for Loan entities, providing data access and complex query functionalities related to loans.

methods.name: getGroupLoansDisbursedAfter
methods.description: Retrieves a list of loans for a specific group that have been disbursed after a given date.

methods.name: getClientOrJLGLoansDisbursedAfter
methods.description: Retrieves loans disbursed after a specified date for a specific client or JLG.

methods.name: getMaxGroupLoanCounter
methods.description: Finds the maximum loan counter value for a group with a specific loan type.

methods.name: getMaxGroupLoanProductCounter
methods.description: Finds the maximum loan product counter for a group with a specific loan type and product.

methods.name: getMaxClientOrJLGLoanCounter
methods.description: Gets the maximum loan counter for a specific client.

methods.name: getMaxClientOrJLGLoanProductCounter
methods.description: Gets the maximum loan product counter for a specific client.

methods.name: getGroupLoansToUpdateLoanCounter
methods.description: Finds group loans with a loan counter greater than a specified value for updating.

methods.name: getClientOrJLGLoansToUpdateLoanCounter
methods.description: Finds client loans with a loan counter greater than a specified value for updating.

methods.name: getGroupLoansToUpdateLoanProductCounter
methods.description: Finds group loans with a loan product counter greater than a specified value for updating.

methods.name: getClientLoansToUpdateLoanProductCounter
methods.description: Finds client loans with a loan product counter greater than a specified value for updating.

methods.name: findByClientIdAndGroupId
methods.description: Retrieves loans for a specific client and group.

methods.name: findByClientIdAndGroupIdAndLoanStatus
methods.description: Retrieves loans for a client and group filtered by given loan statuses.

methods.name: findLoanByClientId
methods.description: Finds all loans associated with a specific client.

methods.name: findByGroupId
methods.description: Finds all loans associated with a specific group where client is null.

methods.name: findByGlimId
methods.description: Retrieves loans associated with a specific GLE (Glim ID).

methods.name: findByIdsAndLoanStatusAndLoanType
methods.description: Retrieves loans matching given IDs, statuses, and types.

methods.name: getLoansDisbursedAfter
methods.description: Retrieves loan IDs for loans disbursed after a specified date.

methods.name: findByClientOfficeIdsAndLoanStatus
methods.description: Finds loans for specific client offices with given statuses.

methods.name: findByGroupOfficeIdsAndLoanStatus
methods.description: Finds loans for specific group offices with given statuses.

methods.name: findActiveLoansLoanProductIdsByClient
methods.description: Retrieves active loan product IDs for a client filter.

methods.name: findActiveLoansLoanProductIdsByGroup
methods.description: Retrieves active loan product IDs for a group filter.

methods.name: doLoanAccountsWithLoansInStatusesExistForClient
methods.description: Checks if loans with specific statuses exist for a client.

methods.name: doLoanAccountsWithLoansInStatusesExistForProduct
methods.description: Checks if loans with specific statuses exist for a product.

methods.name: findLoanByAccountNumberAndStatuses
methods.description: Finds a loan by account number and statuses.

methods.name: findLoanByClientAndStatus
methods.description: Finds a loan for a specific client and loan status.

methods.name: findLoanAccountByAccountNumber
methods.description: Finds a loan by account number.

methods.name: findLoanDataForExternalTransferByLoanId
methods.description: Retrieves external transfer data for a loan by its ID.

methods.name: existsLoanByExternalLoanIdAndStatuses
methods.description: Checks if a loan exists with a specific external ID and statuses.

methods.name: existsByExternalId
methods.description: Checks whether a loan exists with a given external ID.

methods.name: findAllLoanIdsByStatuses
methods.description: Retrieves IDs of all loans with specified statuses.

methods.name: findIdByExternalId
methods.description: Finds a loan's ID by its external ID.

methods.name: findIdsByExternalIds
methods.description: Retrieves loan IDs for a list of external IDs.

methods.name: findAllLoansBehindByLoanIdsAndStatuses
methods.description: Finds loans behind in COB process by loan IDs and statuses.

methods.name: findAllLoansBehindOrNullByLoanIdsAndStatuses
methods.description: Finds loans behind or with null lastClosedBusinessDate.

methods.name: findAllLoansByLastClosedBusinessDateAndMinAndMaxLoanIdAndStatuses
methods.description: Retrieves loans within a range of IDs and specific last closed business date.

methods.name: findAllLoansByLastClosedBusinessDateNotNullAndMinAndMaxLoanIdAndStatuses
methods.description: Retrieves loans with non-null last closed business date within a range.

methods.name: findOldestCOBProcessedLoan
methods.description: Finds the oldest COB processed loans based on business date.

methods.name: findAllStayedLockedByCobBusinessDate
methods.description: Gets all loans that are locked at a specific COB business date.

methods.name: findLoanIdByStatus
methods.description: Retrieves loan IDs for a given status.

methods.name: findLoansForPeriodicAccrual
methods.description: Finds loans eligible for periodic interest accrual based on rules and dates.

methods.name: findLoansForAddAccrual
methods.description: Finds loans eligible for additional accrual.

methods.name: findByExternalId
methods.description: Finds a loan by its external ID.

methods.name: isEnabledCapitalizedIncome
methods.description: Checks if income capitalization is enabled for a loan.

methods.name: isEnabledBuyDownFee
methods.description: Checks if buy-down fee is enabled for a loan.
